# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Nine years old (as of Volume 3)  <sub>[v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c28 P7](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0007)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003), [v3 c28 P9](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a fair and handsome boy with a crop of fuzzy yellow ringlets all over his round head. He has hazel eyes that are roguish and dancing, a snub nose, and a dimple in one cheek that gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs. One of his eyes is blue and the other is hazel.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015)_

## Personality

Davy is full of mischief, energy, and constant motion, often getting into trouble or devising pranks. He is loud, outspoken, and possesses an insatiable curiosity about everything around him. Despite his naughty behavior, he has a warm and loving heart, and he deeply adores Anne Shirley, often seeking her affection and guidance. Over time, he shows a strong desire to improve himself and develop better habits.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c8 P55](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0055), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c19 P45](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0045), [v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were orphaned when their sick mother, Mary Keith, passed away. Marilla Cuthbert took the twins into Green Gables, where Davy quickly earned a reputation for non-stop mischief, such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, putting a toad in Marilla's bed, and hiding Dora in a pigpen. Under the patient guidance of Anne Shirley, Davy formed a deep bond with her, striving to improve his behavior and learn moral lessons. He began attending Avonlea school, sitting alongside Milty Boulter, and over the years gradually grew out of his extreme naughtiness. Following the death of his uncle Richard Keith, a trust fund was established for Davy and Dora's support, allowing them to remain permanently at Green Gables. As he grew older, he developed a strong interest in farming and took on chores around the property.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v3 c18 P4](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0004), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)_
